$reason: `option-in-a-list-under-a-hidden-container` inside an `<svg>`, where the parser names the container `:svg:ng-container`. The compiler draws it as it does outside, as a comment (`ɵɵdomElementContainer`, measured with `ngc` 22.2.1), and the `aria-hidden` reaches no element, so the option and the `list` it stands in are in the tree under the listbox (measured: Angular 22.2; axe 4.13 reports the option). A reading that asked the raw name whether the tag was Angular's own read the container as an element that hides, and passed the option; asked by the local name, the container is Angular's own, and what is written on it is refused as it is outside.
